text: The Patriots face the Jaguars in Week 3 with some notable roster adjustments in place: Carlton Davis III is set to return at cornerback, while the team has ruled out OLB Dre'Mont Jones with a shoulder injury and placed rookie LB Quintayvious Hutchins on injured reserve following a knee injury, though rookie TE Eli Raridon returned to practice as his status is being monitored heading into Sunday. Jacksonville, meanwhile, is seeking a strong response after what they're characterizing as their worst offensive performance in eleven months, with Trevor Lawrence and company viewing the Patriots as a team still "finding ourselves." The Patriots, for their part, will need to tighten up clock management before halftime after two consecutive games featured questionable decisions late in the second quarter—a area where the team has acknowledged room for improvement. Off the field, Christian Gonzalez and Andy Borregales joined the Patriots organization in celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month at an event in Boston hosted by the New England Patriots Foundation, IBA, and Bank of America.
